notes.title: v0.10.4
notes.content:
This is a fairly large change from the last time there was a 'default' playtest build, and that's because we're releasing for Steam NextFest soon and a bunch of changes have happened in the meantime! Some highlights:

[list]
[*] An entirely revamped map with more assets and different paths
[*] Dynamic music
[*] Updates to the cutscenes and skip logic
[*] Lots of performance improvements
[*] Adding portrait expressions for all the characters
[*] Various UI changes, especially for added accessibility on controller.
[/list]

Please let me know if you see any issues! The map is 'set' for the demo now and won't go through any major changes, but if anything is broken, we still have time to fix them.

notes.title: v0.7.10
notes.content:
This is a major change, updating the default branch of the playtest to be synced with the beta version. Many changes have occurred since the last default update:

[list]
[*] [b]Major revamp of collisions logic[/b] - you should no longer get stuck in geometry or on top of trash piles. 
[*] [b]Add checkpoint feature in main menu[/b] - in the rare event you do get stuck (possibly if you destroy a ring of trash around yourself), this feature allows you to warp back to a previous checkpoint.
[*] [b]Add sprint feature[/b] - you can now run (temporarily) faster by holding SHIFT (left face button on controller).
[*] [b]New demo ending splash screen[/b]
[*] General faster movement speed
[*] Improve performance of UI
[*] Add auto-advance text mode and settings for controlling this
[*] Add save file thumbnails
[*] Add continue / auto mode indicator to textbox
[*] Fix issue where Persis's shawl might clip through her shoulder
[*] Fix control tooltip issues on Steam Deck
[*] Fix some sounds not respecting the SFX slider
[*] Add new sound effects to certain weapons
[*] Fix issue where fragments could disappear while you were in dialogue
[*] Fix duplicate resolutions in graphics / display settings
[*] Fix issues where scrolling lists with keyboard or controller would not move scrollbars
[/list]
